$comment:
Validated shape/precision envelope for dots.mocr on N300 (1x1 mesh).
Values marked TBD-MEASURED come from Phase 2 hardware sweeps; values marked AUDIT come from source-code analysis (Phase 1).
Update this file by re-running validation/scripts/probe_*.py and copying the resulting thresholds.

max_seq_len.purpose: Sizes the per-block KV / mask buffers in VisionAttention. NOT a numerics knob.
max_seq_len.loud_failure_above: OOM if >> available DRAM (Category A1, bank_manager.cpp:434)

padded_sl.purpose: Per-image padded sequence length, derived as ((unp//2048)+1)*2048 in DropInVisionTransformer.forward (model.py:231). Caller cannot control directly; it follows from the input image dimensions.
padded_sl.note: B1 case: unp=2259 -> sl=4096 with N_TT=5 silently corrupts the hidden state. The threshold is a function of (sl, n_tt, weight_dtype). With dtype=bfloat16 throughout the threshold rises sharply (cost: ~30% slower vision).

n_tt_blocks.purpose: How many of the 42 vision blocks run on TT (rest on CPU fp32).

max_cache_seq.purpose: Tile-aligned upper bound for the per-layer KV cache (28 layers, n_kv_heads=2, head_dim=128, dtype=bf16).
max_cache_seq.loud_failure_above: OOM at allocation time when total KV bytes (28 layers * 2 heads * max_cache * 128 * 2B * 2 (K+V)) plus working set exceeds DRAM (Category A1).

kv_dtype.purpose: Storage precision for the K and V tensors of every decoder layer.
kv_dtype.note: GQA path additionally rejects bfloat8_b/bfloat4_b for Q (sdpa_decode_device_operation.cpp:312).

prefill_seq_for_argmax_stability.purpose: Maximum prompt length (post-vision-prefill) for which TT decoder argmax remains stable vs HF fp32 over MAX_NEW=180 steps.
prefill_seq_for_argmax_stability.note: Below ~2000 the bf16 KV cumulative drift stays below the argmax-flipping threshold even with HiFi4/fp32_dest_acc. Between 2000-2791 occasional flips appear. At 2791 NewMind sees first divergence at decode step 39.

k_chunk_size_for_sdpa.purpose: K-dimension chunk size used by the prefill SDPA program config.
k_chunk_size_for_sdpa.loud_failure_for: any value not a multiple of 32 (sdpa_device_operation.cpp:152-156, sdpa_decode_device_operation.cpp:228)

kv_layout.note: The shape passes the rank-4 + dim-equality validators because k_shape[0]=1=B; the kernel may misinterpret dim 1 as the batch axis instead of the GQA-head axis.
